1.consolidated_definition: Casa remolque. Vehículo con las comodidades de una vivienda. Calco de estructura, frecuente. Primeros Auxilios está ubicada en una casa móvil entre el edificio principal presidencial y el edificio que comprende los programas de ASCIENDE, el Instituto Central y El Programa Graduado (El Halcón, Universidad Central de )
1.en_consolidated_definition: Mobile home. Vehicle equipped with the amenities of a dwelling. Calque of structure, frequent. First Aid is located in a mobile house between the main presidential building and the building that comprises the ASCIENDE programs, the Central Institute, and The Graduate Program (The Falcon, Central University)
